gamerule.pdopnTemperature.description: When off, body temperature no longer changes and causes no effects or death.
gamerule.pdopnThirst.description: When off, hydration is not consumed and dehydration causes no damage.
gamerule.pdopnDrift.description: When off, the Perpetual Day/Night time lock still applies, but drift no longer accumulates daily.
gamerule.pdopnMaxDrift.description: Absolute cap on accumulated drift (°C). 0 means unlimited. The default 100 matches the lethal body temperature.
gamerule.pdopnBlockTemp.description: Whether nearby dangerous blocks (lava, fire, ice, etc.) affect body temperature.
gamerule.pdopnLethalDamage.description: When off you still overheat, freeze and dehydrate, but will not die from them.
gamerule.pdopnMobBoost.description: Whether hostile mobs get boosted health, speed and attack in Perpetual Day/Night modes.
gamerule.pdopnNeutralAggro.description: Whether neutral mobs (Enderman, Spider, Zombie Piglin, etc.) actively track players.
gamerule.pdopnHudDefault.description: Whether new players see the temperature and thirst HUD by default. Players who toggled it off keep their choice.
gamerule.pdopnMaxDaysEnforce.description: When on, reaching the configured maxDays automatically reverts to the normal day/night cycle; when off it only warns once.
